The road was very long. The little girl hurried on. She was tired and she
became very weak. She needed water, but she did not drink. She had
already given the water to the thirsty dog and the old woman. Her mother
would need the rest of the water. She walked fast again.
After a few minutes, the girl reached
home and gave the water to her
mother. Her mother drank water and
quenched her thirst.
